title: Glossary
text: Oska Terms of the security model. Authority Capability: An unforgeable value that grants authority. _Avoid_: permission, token Attenuation: Producing a narrower capability, as fs.restrict_to("docs") does. See the design.

title: Oska design notes
text: Oska design notes Decisions are in adr/, terms in GLOSSARY.md, and the background in the research. Principles 1. Secure by default. The safe path is the shortest. 2. No ambient authority. See ADR 0002. 3. Legible. A snake_case_name stays as it is, and so does 2 3 4. Capabilities - Fs attenuates: - to FsRead or FsWrite - to one directory, with restrict_to - Confinement. A restricted filesystem resolves every path: 1. An empty path is refused. 2. The path is canonicalized. Residual risk. A race remains, as Untrusted data explains. - A code block in an item: fn main(fs: FsRead) { let docs = fs.restrict_to("docs") } 3. A list that starts at three 4. keeps its number. Untrusted data and sinks Sink Data position Structural position SQL (std.sql) Parameters The query, an sql"..." literal Closures x x in code Text is untrusted when it comes from outside, and __trusted__ text is written in the program. An escaped *star* is not emphasis, and a b is code. Sinks Headings at every level get an anchor. Fourth Fifth Sixth
